explanation: The theorem gives a local lower bound C‖z − w‖ ≤ sup over pairs (i, j) of ‖φ(z)_i φ(w)_j − φ(z)_j φ(w)_i‖, the 2×2 minors (wedge coordinates), for a holomorphic vector-valued map φ, assuming the wedge φ(c) ∧ φ′(c) is nonzero. This is a specialised result. The proof combines several Mathlib ingredients: continuity of the derivative, the mean value inequality `Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le`, and `le_ciSup`. None of them states the result alone. I searched Mathlib for the names wedge_deriv, norm_minor and iSup_norm_minor (no matches). I also considered antilipschitz and strict-derivative style lemmas (e.g. HasStrictFDerivAt). Getting from those to a statement about minors would take a real argument, not one or two lines.
